versions.changelog:
Initial release of xiangshan-douyin.

- Provides Douyin (抖音) API tools to search users/videos, and fetch user profiles, video details, comments, and play statistics.
- Supports input parsing: share links, user/video IDs, or keywords.
- Guides user to provide API Key if not set in environment.
- Introduces seven API endpoints for user/video data and search.
- Includes user-friendly step-by-step workflow and usage rules.
